title: eval-harness: add prompt-set regression CI hooks and quality gating for canary models
author: Asha Patel
release_notes: Added CI hooks to run prompt-set regression checks and a configurable quality gate for canary model rollouts.
description: This PR introduces CI hooks and a quality-gating mechanism in the eval-harness to automatically detect prompt-set regressions during PRs and canary rollouts. Motivation: avoid subtle prompt regressions from impacting downstream services during model swaps and infra changes. Changes include: 1) new GitHub Actions job `eval-prompt-regression` that runs a targeted subset of prompt sets marked as stable and canary, 2) a gating library that computes delta metrics (EM, BLEU, custom scoring) and fails the job if regressions exceed configurable thresholds, 3) integration with the existing canary pipeline so rollouts can opt into automatic blocking, 4) lightweight caching of eval outputs to reduce CI runtime for unchanged prompt sets, 5) documentation and Linear links. Checklist: [x] CI job implemented; [x] gating thresholds configurable via eval-config.yaml; [x] tests and sample prompt sets added; [x] docs updated under docs/eval-harness/ci.md. See Linear ENG-4821 for rollout plan and QA-137 for test matrix. This is intended to be non-breaking; teams can opt-in via repo-level eval-config.yaml.
